items.name: Cell phone
items.description: An ordinary personal phone for routine calls and messages.

items.name: Flashlight
items.description: A handheld light. The GC decides illumination and any situational use.

items.name: Notebook and pen
items.description: Paper notes and a writing tool for observations, messages or sketches.

items.name: Binoculars
items.description: Ordinary binoculars for watching distant activity; use the Common Item rules.

items.name: Handcuffs
items.description: A conventional pair of restraints; restraint and escape procedures still apply.

items.name: Backpack
items.description: A simple container for the character’s carried equipment.

items.name: Compass
items.description: A basic magnetic compass for orientation.

items.name: Canteen
items.description: A water container for ordinary field use.

items.name: Duct tape
items.description: A roll of utility tape; improvised uses are for the GC to assess.

items.name: Multitool
items.description: A pocket collection of simple tools; professional checks still use their required kits.

items.name: Storage media
items.description: Ordinary removable media for carrying copies of files.

items.name: Stretcher
items.description: A folding casualty carrier; it does not provide medical treatment.

items.name: Road flares
items.description: A small roadside signal supply; the GC determines burn time and safe placement.

items.name: Fire extinguisher
items.description: An ordinary portable extinguisher for a small fire, subject to the hazard rules.

items.name: Briefcase
items.description: A conventional document case with no concealed devices or special protection.
